### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Style: Warm, natural and conversational, like a public radio host explaining a local story to a neighbor. Curious and even-handed: this story is about order, not whether. Open with a light, dry half-smile on the first line. Report the mayor's complaint plainly and without sneering, and give the company's side a sincere, fair hearing, especially the line that begins "In fairness". Pace: MEASURED and unhurried. THIS IS A TWO MINUTE PIECE, about one hundred and twenty seconds, and the read must FILL it, so give every sentence room to land and take a real breath at every period. Do not rush the numbers. Vary the tone line to line so no two sentences sound the same.

Transcript:
Someone asked to take a number for Cook Inlet.
A Needham, Massachusetts company asked federal regulators, FERC, to study an underwater data center.
The plan calls for sixty-six seabed pods and about three hundred thirty to three hundred fifty tidal turbines.
About a hundred megawatts, mostly for the data center, and a proposed three and a half mile cable to Nikiski.
A preliminary permit only lets the holder study the site and claim first place in line to apply for a license.
As the company put it, a preliminary permit doesn't give us permission to build anything.
The formal deadline for objections was five p.m. Eastern on November second.
Kenai Peninsula Borough Mayor Peter Micciche called the company's approach sloppy. [short pause] He said he hadn't had an email, letter or call from it.
The company said it was too early to reach out, before the engineering and biology work was done on paper.
A commercial fisheries alliance says the proposal didn't assess effects on more than thirteen hundred active permits, and the Center for Biological Diversity filed to intervene.
In fairness to the company, a study is how anyone gets answers, and this permit wouldn't allow construction.
Cook Inlet belugas have been listed as endangered since two thousand eight. NOAA's best estimate is three hundred thirty-one whales, down from about thirteen hundred in nineteen seventy-nine.
With a population that small, the question isn't whether to study. [short pause] It's who's in the room when the study is designed.
FERC hasn't ruled yet, so should the borough, the fleet and NOAA's beluga scientists help write the study terms?
